༄༅// bsang mchod kyi cho ga'i rnam par bshad pa tshogs gnyis chu gter 'phel ba'i zla ba zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄// sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta ak+ṣa ra bcu gcig pa gsum bsngags la/ spyir gyi rnam grangs nyis stong zhe brgyad mchis pa'i nang gsal sum brgya nga bdun pa nas rnyed pa dngos bstan dbang po rdo rje zhes bya ba'i prāstā ras bcings pa'o// ༄// sarbadz+nyamaṇ+ḍal+yakulash+tsasarbaṃshastābrabhurbadz+radharas+saman+ya/ t+satwobhagaḥsāmanakāyadesh+yār+thaḥkār+yalak+ṣ+mīgurawanamāmi// ༄// kun mkhyen rigs dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi// khyab bdag ston pa rdo rje 'chang mtshungs las// sems can skal ba mnyam pa'i skur bstan nas// don mdzad dpal ldan bla mar phyag bgyi'o// che ba'i yon tan pha rol kun gsal ma'i// 'jal byed stong gis ma phyin skyengs pa'i mtshang*// mkha' gling stug pos bsgribs snyam skyabs kyi yul// bla ma rgyal ba sras slob bcas la 'dud// srid zhi'i mgron gyi rigs gyur ji snyed gzugs// gnam sa'i me long yangs pa'i ngos khyab pa// bsang mchog cho ga'i pra snang mgron gnyer nas// sbyin bzhis tshim par byed gang sbyin pa'i bdag /dkon mchog gsum po skyabs su bzung nas brtsams// bslab bya dkon mchog mchod dang sbyin yul la// brtse bas sbyin bzhi'i mthar phyin bsgrub pa 'dir// gto bon chos su khas 'che bab col gtam// skyabs yul lta spyod phyin ci log pa dang*// ma ldog khyad par la ltos phyi nang gi /rnam dbyer dpyad kyin smra ba blo ldan lugs// yin phyir 'khyal gtam rjes su su zhig 'brang*// dag byed dri zhim sprin gyis nyer mtshon pa'i// 'dod yon 'dzad med 'jo bas mchod sbyin gyi// mgron du gnyer dgu dgyes shing tshim byed pas// tshogs zung dbyer med sgrub la 'di rmad byung*// bsang mchod sngon rabs grub pa'i tshul chen la// lung dang rigs pas yid ches bskyed pa 'dis// ched du ma gnyer rnying bon lugs srol du// zhal 'ches pa rnams smra bcad brtul zhugs 'chang*// zhes shis brjod dang dngos po nges bstan gyi brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas/

'dir skabs su bab pa'i gleng ba/ rga klung mchod rten dkar po'i phyogs nas sngags spyod dang rtsis rigs sogs rig pa'i gzhung la sbyangs stobs pa mi dman pa'i bla mkhyen o rgyan dpal bzang pa nas/ 'di skad du/ sa 'dzin dkar pos yongs bskor sman ljongs 'dir// bsang mchod dar che lag len byed mang yang*// rgyu mtshan tshul bzhin shes pa ches dkon pas// the tshom 'grol ba'i zhal gdams gsal rgyas zhu// zhes sogs bsang gi byung khungs dang sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bar dgos tshul byung bar brten/ bsang gi rnam par gzhag pa cung zad nges par byed pa la gsum ste/ bsang gi byung khungs bstan pa/ bsang mchod kyi rnam par gzhag pa/ mjug phan yon bstan pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ dbye ba rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ bsang mchod 'bul ba'i cho ga 'di dag mchod yul mchod pas mnyes par byed pa dang*/ sbyin yul sbyin pas tshim par byed pa'i sgo nas tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong gi thabs khyad par ba ste/ dper na chu la brten nas gtor ma btang ba dang*/ me la brten nas sbyin sreg byed pa/ bza' bca' la brten nas mchod gtor 'bul ba la sogs pa dang mtshungs par/ 'dir yang dri zhim ngad pa la brten nas mchod pa 'bul ba ste/ bsang mchod bon gto'i lugs dang glo bur du byung ba zhig yin par smra na/ de dag sogs kyang de dang mtshungs te khyad par med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye ba rgyas par bshad pa la bzhi ste/ mtshan nyid/ nges tshig dbye ba/ dbye ba'i gzhi'o// dang po ni/ dag byed dri zhim gyi mchod pa'i cho ga gang zhig nyes skyon gyi sgrib byed thams cad sbyang zhing*/ bde legs ster ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa nyid do// gnyis pa ni legs sbyar gyi skad du/ sho dha na dang*/ mar+ṣaṭiḥ shud+dha zhes pa rnams dag byed la 'jug pa dang*/ mṛ dzā dang*/ mārdza na dang*/ snā ta dang*/ pū ta dang*/ shaud+dhaḥzhes pa rnams gtsang byed la 'jug ste/

de ltar na dag byed kyi rdzas dang lhan cig par mchod pa'i cho ga la brten nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs nas dag cing gtsang bar byed ces pa'i don to// yang na dhū pa dang*/ dhū pa na dang*/ dhū pa ya ti dang*/ pra bod+dha naṃ/ bān+ti kṛ taḥ zhes pa rnams bdug pa dang*/ bdug par byed pa dang*/ rab tu bsang bar byed pa dang*/ sbyong bar byed pa rnams la 'jug ste/ de ltar na/ spos dang spos kyi bdug pa so sor ma phye bar bsang bar byed pa'i mchod pa'i cho gas nyes skyon thams cad khrus kyis dri ma 'khrud pa ltar bsal zhing sbyang ba dang*/ gtsang zhing dag par byed pa'i don du gzung ngo*// yang na me d+dha dang*/ me d+dh+yā zhes pa mchod sbyin cho ga la 'jug ste/ mchod sbyin gyi yul du gyur pa gang dag dri zhim spos kyi ngad pa la brten pa'i mchod rdzas gya nom pas dgyes shing tshim par byed ces pa'i don to// gsum pa la gnyis te/ thabs kyis ma zin pa dang*/ thabs kyis zin pa'i gnas skabs so// dang po ni/ mdo rgya che rol pa las/ srid sred ma rig dbang gis skye bo rnams// mi dang lha gnas ngan song rnam gsum po// 'gro ba lnga po rnams su mi mkhas 'khor// dper na rdza mkhan 'phang lo 'khor ba bzhin// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'khor bar 'khor ba'i rkyen gyi rgyu 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ste/ des rgyu ji ltar byed pa'i tshul yang*/ 'khor 'das kyi byed pa po sems nyid yin te/ des ni yul de dag gi rang bzhin ma shes par bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa'i sgo nas yul la mngon par zhen pa skye'o// de la brten nas rnam rtog sna tshogs 'byung ba ni ma rig pa dang sred len gnyis te de dag ni nyon mongs pa'i kun nas nyon mongs pa zhes bya'o// de la brten nas las dge ba dang mi dge ba mngon par 'du byed pa'i 'du byed dang srid pa ste/ de dag ni las kyi kun nas nyon mongs pa'o// de las 'gro ba drug po rnams su rnam par shes pa dang*/

ming gzugs dang*/ skye mched drug dang*/ reg pa dang*/ tshor ba dang*/ skye ba dang*/ rga shi zhes bya ba bdun ni skye ba'i kun nas nyon mongs pa ste/ de gsum gyis bsdus pa'i yan lag bcu gnyis kyis yang 'byung rnams su 'khor zhing skye bar 'gyur la/ de dag la kun nas nyon mongs pa'i rten 'brel zhes bya'o// de dag gi rang bzhin shes pas rim gyi 'gags pas rnam par byang ba'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ba ste/ kye rdo rje las/ skye bo mi bzad pa yi las// gang dang gang gis 'ching 'gyur ba// zhes so// des na mngon par 'dus byas pa'i chos de la dbye na/ mdzod las/ 'dus byas chos rnams de dag la// gzugs la sogs pa'i phung po lnga// zhes pa ltar/ sogs pas tshor ba dang*/ 'du shes dang*/ 'du byed dang*/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang ste lnga'o// de'i dang po gzugs kyi phung po la dbye na/ mdzod las/ gzugs ni dbang po lnga dang don// lnga dang rnam rig byed min nyid// ces 'byung ba ltar bcu gcig go /de la'ang cung zad bshad na/ yul dpyad pas gzugs su rung ba kha dog dang dbyibs la sogs pa 'di dang 'di lta bu'o zhes yid kyis rtog pa dang mtshungs par ldan pas bkra bar 'dzin pa dang*/ mnyam par bzhag pa na shes bya'i dngos po dang mthun par 'di dang 'di'o zhes 'dzin pa blo la phyogs cha dang bcas pas snang ba'o// reg pas gzugs su rung ba ni lag pa la sogs pa 'dus te reg pas gzugs kyi rnam pa sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i gzhan du 'gyur ba'i rnam 'gyur mi 'dra bar bskyed du rung ba'o// dbang po lnga ni/ ji skad du/ bstan med thogs dang bcas pa yi// gzugs dang ba ni dbang po lnga// zhes pa ltar te/ mig gi dbang po'i rdul phra rab ni/ mig gi bu chung nang du zar ma'i me tog lta bur gnas so// rna ba'i dbang po'i rdul phra rab ni/ rna 'brug gi nang du gro ga'i 'dzer bu lta bu dang*/ sna'i dbang po'i rdul phra rab ni/

mtshul pa'i nang na zangs kyi thur ma lta bu dang*/ lce'i dbang po'i rdul phra rab ni/ lce'i dbus na zla ba bkas pa lta bu skra rtse'i khyon tsam zhig gnas pa dang*/ lus kyi dbang po'i rdul phra rab ni bya reg 'jam gyi spu dang 'dra bar lus thams cad du khyab par gnas so// don lnga ni/ ji skad du/ gzugs rnams gnyis dang rnam nyi shu// sgra ni rnam pa brgyad yod do// ro ni rnam drug dri rnam bzhi// reg bya bcu gcig bdag nyid do// zhes 'byung ba ltar te/ de'ang gzugs thams cad kha dog gi gzugs dang dbyibs kyi gzugs gnyis su 'du ste/ kha dog ni sngo ser dkar dmar bzhi'o// dbyibs ni ring po dang*/ thung ngu dang*/ zlum po dang*/ lham pa ste gru bzhi dang*/ mthon po dang*/ dma' ba dang*/ phya le ba dang*/ phya le ba ma yin pa ste brgyad dang*/ sprin dang*/ du ba dang*/ nyi zer gyi rdul dang*/ khug rna dang*/ grib ma dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ snang ba dang*/ mun pa ste yan lag gi kha dog brgyad de bstan du yod pa'o// gnyis pa sgra ni sems can gyi rgyud kyis zin pa ngag gi sgra dang*/ ma zin pa 'byung ba la sogs pa'i sgra gnyis/ de re re la'ang lung du ston pa dang*/ lung du mi ston pa'i sgra gnyis yod pas bzhi/ de re re la'ang yid du 'ong ba dang mi 'ong ba'i dbye bas brgyad du 'gyur ro// gsum pa dri ni sna'i dbang po dang mthun pa'i dri zhim pa dang dri mi zhim pa dang*/ de dag shas mnyam pa dang*/ mi mnyam pa ste bzhi'o// bzhi pa ro ni mngar ba dang skyur ba dang*/ lan tshwa dang tsha ba dang*/ kha ba dang*/ bska ba ste drug go /lnga pa reg bya ni rgyu 'bras gnyis las/ dang po ni sra ba sa'i khams dang*/ gsher ba chu'i khams dang*/ dro ba me'i khams dang*/ g.yo ba rlung gi khams so// 'bras bu'i reg bya ni/ 'jam pa dang*/ rtsub pa dang*/ lci ba dang*/ yang ba dang*/ bkres pa dang*/ skom pa ste bcu gcig go /de dag ni bstan med thogs pa dang bcas pa'i gzugs so// bzhi pa rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs ni/

kun slong gi sems gzhan la rig par mi byed pas/ rnam rig byed min gyi gzugs gsum ste/ sdom pa dang*/ sdom min/ bar ma'i ste/ de dag ni bstan med thogs med kyi gzugs so// de dag ni gzugs kyi gzhi dang gzugs kyi phung po'o// sems ni rnam par shes pa'i tshogs drug ste/ mig gi rnam par shes pa dang*/ rna ba dang*/ sna dang*/ lce dang*/ lus dang*/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa drug go /sems byung la sogs pa ni dgos skabs cher ma bab pas 'dir mi 'dri'o// de skad bshad pa'i yul dang yul can rnams la thabs kyis ma zin par ma rig pa la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa gsum gyi dbang du song bas chags sdang rmongs gsum gyis kun nas bslangs pa'i las bsags pas sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa la longs spyod dgos pa byung ba yin la/ de bas na 'khor ba'i 'gro ba rnams la'ang gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi rtog pa shar tshun chad nas/ yul gzugs dang*/ sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ reg bya rnams yid du 'ong ba la chags pa dang*/ yid du mi 'ong ba la sdang ba dang*/ bar ma la gti mug pa'i rtog pa skyes tsam gyi dus nas/ yul 'dod pa lnga rang gis don du gnyer ba dang gzhan gyis stob pa bcas yod la/ de bzhin du dri bzang po la bsnam pa/ gtsang zhing dag pa la dga' ba dang lus la dri zhim pos byug pa dang*/ de dag rang gis lhur byed pa 'dod gzugs kyi 'gro ba spyi dang bye brag tu dri za'i rgyal po rab dga' la sogs pa dang*/ ston pa'i bka' lung mang po nas gdon gyi rigs su gtogs pa'ang zas su phreng ba za ba/ zas su dri za ba/ zas su bdug pa za ba/ zas su me tog za ba/ zas su 'bras bu za ba/ zas su lo tog za ba/ zas su sbyin sreg za ba sogs gsungs pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang mdzod las/ mi ldog de ni dri za'o zhes dang*/ de ni yid las byung dang dri za zhes bya'o// zhes pa lta bu'i dri la za ba mang du yod pa'i phyir dang*/

de dag la gzhan gyis byug pa ster ba dang*/ dris mngad par byed par bcas thog ma nyid nas yod mod/ de dag gi de kho na nyid ma shes pa'am/ thabs khyad par can gyis ma zin pas ma gtogs/ bsang dang dag byed dang gtsang byed dang dri zhim gyi gnas la mngon par dga' zhing len pa dang 'bul ba bcas yod pa rnams kyang bsang mchod 'bul ba las gzhan ma yin pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa thabs kyis zin pa la'ang gnyis te/ thabs dman pas zin pa dang*/ khyad par bas zin pa'o// dang po ni/ yul de dag lam du byed pa la/ phyi rol mu stegs byed la rig byed tshad mar 'dod pa'i log par rtog pa'i dbang gis 'jug pa'i tshul bzhi yod de/ 'dod chags can lha chen po'i rjes su 'brang ba/ 'dod chags chos su smra ba dag ni/ thob bya'i 'bras bu dbang phyug chen po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la dmigs nas/ rang gi lugs kyi dbang blangs nas/ rlung bum pa can la sogs pa'i man ngag la brten nas/ dus khyad par can ma dang sring mo la sogs pa la'ang longs spyod par byed de/ ji skad du/ gau tam bud med me yin te// de yi nye gnas me thab yin// de yi spu ni du ba ste// de yi nang zhugs sol ba yin// zhes bya ba la sogs pa dang*/ de bzhin du sha lnga la sogs pa bza' zhing khyi phag gi spyod pa dang brtul zhugs byed pa yod/ kha cig zhe sdang can khyab 'jug gi rjes su 'brangs nas 'tshe ba chos su smra ba yod de/ thob bya khyab 'jug sprul pa'i sku la dmigs nas/ rang gi lha rten gyi drung du byol song dang*/ mi la sogs pa srog gcod pa'i mchod sbyin byed de/ mchod sbyin gyi rig byed las/ bar gyi dus la bab pa na// byol song drug gam bdun skyar bya// rta yis gtsang ma'i rigs yin no// nyung na byol song gsum gyis so// zhes dang*/ rgyal rigs la ni rgyal rigs gsad// bram ze la ni bram ze gsad// ma rungs dag la rje rigs te// rmongs rigs la ni rmongs rigs gsad// ces so// kha cig gti mug can tshangs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas gtsang sbra dag chos su smra ba yod de/

thob bya tshangs pa chos kyi sku la dmigs nas/ bram zer skyes pa dang bgrang gzhi bcu gnyis lon nas dbang bskur bas na/ des bya ba'i las kyang rig byed bzhi las ji ltar 'byung ba gtsang ba'i spyod pa byed de/ snga bar langs nas 'chag sa che chung du bcags nas/ sa'i khrus/ chu'i khrus rnams byas te/ tshangs skud dang ku sha dang ril ba thogs te me la sbyin sreg byed de/ me chu spyon dang por mchod sbyin la phan no// lha'i nang na mchog tu gyur pa sbyin sreg gi gnas rin po che sbyin par byed pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod do// yang des smyung bar gnas pa'ang byed de/ nub gcig gam ni nub gsum mam// bdun du'am ni nyin gcig nyid// gang zhig smyung bar gnas pa yis// skye bo de ni mtho ris 'gro// zhes dang*/ yang des gtsang sbra'i spyod pas grol bar 'dod pa dang*/ 'bab stegs su khrus byas pas sdig pa 'dag par 'dod de/ 'dag chal dag gis bgos pa'i gos// dri ma med par 'gyur ba bzhin// lus can mchod sbyin gyis bgos pa// 'bab stegs bkrus pas de ltar 'dag /ces zer ro// des na phyi rol pa'i grub mtha' chos su 'dod pa rnams su'ang*/ khrus byed pa dang gtsang sbrar bsten pa dang*/ dka' spyad drag por bzod pa dang*/ smyung bar gnas pa dang*/ yo byad gtsang mas zhi ba dang rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gam mchod sbyin gyi cho ga byed pa la sogs pa yod do// de dag kyang don thob tu bsang dang dag byed dang gtsang byed dang zhi byed sbyin sreg la brten nas rang gi lha mtshun sogs la mchod pa byed pa rnams yod pa'i phyir dang*/ de lta bu'i nyes pa bsang ba dang dag byed kyi cho ga dang gtsang sbra'i spyod pa spyad pas grol bar 'dod pa dag yod do// 'on kyang de dag skyabs gnas log pa dang*/ lta ba bdag med pa dang mi ldan pa dang*/ thabs la mi mkhas pa dang snying rjes dben pas ngan song gi rgyur 'gyur ba yin no// gnyis pa la/

gzhi de dag spong ba lam du byed pa dang*/ gzhi mi spong ba lam du byed pa gnyis las/ dang po la gnyis te/ yul la mi mthun par blta ba dang*/ de spong ba'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la legs par brtags nas skyo bar bskyed cing*/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu gang las byung ba yin snyam du brtags pa na/ rgyu nyon mongs pa las byung ba shes shing*/ de'ang yul de dag la brten te skye bar 'gyur la/ des na yul rnams ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu yin no zhes mi mthun par blta ba ste/ mdo las/ 'dod pa rnams ni dug gi lo ma lta bu zhes dang*/ slob springs las/ yul dang dug mtshungs dang por myong ba tsam na bde// yul dang dug mtshungs rnam smin rtsub pa mi bzad pa// yul dang dug mtshungs gti mug mun pas thibs por byed// yul dang dug mtshungs shugs bzlog dka' zhing g.yo ba yin// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i yul la chags pa ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyur 'du shes bskyed do// gnyis pa ni/ sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs te/ de las thar par 'dod pas/ so thar gyi sdom pa blang ba/ blangs nas bsrung ba'o// dang po ni/ 'gal rkyen bar chad med pas mthun rkyen tshang ba na/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ so thar ris brgyad gang rung gi sdom pa len pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ de dag gi bslab bya ris brgyad so so'i skabs nas 'byung ba la bslab cing*/ thun mong du dkon mchog gsum srog gi phyir yang mi spong ba dang*/ bya ba thams cad kyang dkon mchog la blo gtad pa dang*/ dkon mchog la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ me tog dang*/ bdug pa dang*/ mar me la sogs pa 'dod pa'i yon tan ci 'byor pa thams cad kyang dkon mchog mchod pa'i phyir 'bad par byed pa yin no// de ltar tshul khrims kyi bslab pa blangs te/ rtag tu bag yod pa'i tshul gyis bsrung zhing de'i brtul zhugs dang gtsang sbra'i spyod pa khrus bya ba dang chab len pa rnams kyang nyes pa dag byed kyi thabs su ston pas gnang ba yin la/

de'i 'og tu lung dang rigs pa'i thos bsam gyis yul gyi rang bzhin shes par byas nas yul la zhen pa bral ba'i tshul gyis spang bar byed pa dang*/ khyad par tshul khrims ni/ so so thar pa ris brgyad de/ mdzod las/ so thar zhes bya rnam pa brgyad// rdzas su rnam pa bzhi yin no// mtshan las ming ni 'pho ba'i phyir// tha dad de dag 'gal ba med// spang bya lnga brgyad bcu dang ni// thams cad spong ba nos pa las// dge bsnyen dang ni bsnyen gnas dang*// dge tshul byed dang dge slong nyid// ces pa ltar rang rang gi spang bya rnams tshul bzhin bsrung ba nyid de/ de ni sa ga lhas/ 'dul ba tshig ler/ de la 'dir ni rnam kun du// 'dul ba min pas dag pa med// ji ltar chu med 'dag chal gyis// mnyes kyang dri ma mi 'dag bzhin// zhes dang*/ gzhan du/ tshul khrims 'di ni gtsang ba ste// zhes dang*/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ tshul khrims kyi gtam las/ ji ltar tshul khrims bla med ldan pa'i dri// dam pa mtho ris 'di na mi zad ldan// de ltar phreng ba'i dri ni khyab med cing*// de bzhin byug pa'i dri yang 'byung min 'gyur// zhes sogs 'byung ba'i phyir/ nyes spyod bsdams shing gtsang bar byed pa dang*/ dag byed dang dri zhim bsung mchod rgyal ba mnyes byed kyi gtso bo ni/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa yang dag par 'dzin pa nyid yin zhing*/ nyan thos rnams de bzhin gshegs pa dang de'i rten spyan 'dren pa la sogs pa'i tshe na'ang sa gzhi thams cad dri zhim po'i spos chus byug pa dang*/ me tog dang spos la sogs pas mchod kyin spyan 'dren par byed pa'ang*/ sa ga lhas/ 'jig rten mgon pos 'jig rten gyi// yams kyi 'tshe ba zhi bya'i phyir// sangs rgyas sku gzugs grong sogs su// spyan drangs par ni gsungs pa yin// der ni chag chag byug pa dang*// srang gi gzhi mdor sa gzhi la// sna tshogs me tog bkod pa yis// rab tu mdzes par bya ba yin// tsan+dan a gar ga pur gyi// bdug spos kun nas dbul bar bya// phyogs kyi sgo nas dri zhim dag

/dal zhing dal ba'i rlung gis bskyod// zhes bya ba sogs mchod pa'i bye brag mang pos bkur stir byed pa rnams bshad do// gzhan yang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song bas/ dngos rdzas gang dag byung ba bdag gir mi bgyid par yon tan gyi zhing dam par gyur pa dkon mchog la nye bar spyod pa 'dod pa'i yo byad du byas nas mchod pa dang*/ phan yon gyi zhing mgon med rnams la sbyin pa sogs nas/ zas kyi phud lhag dkon mchog la mchod nas 'phrog ma dang lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la sbyin pa'i bar thams cad kyang mchod pa 'bul ba dang sbyin pa bya bar bshad pa ltar/ 'dir bsang gi cho ga byed pa 'di dag kyang 'dod yon bsang rdzas dpag tu med pa'i mchod sprin gyis mchod yul mnyes par byed pa dang*/ sbyin yul tshim par byed pa'i thabs las gzhan ma yin pa'i phyir/ des na 'dod yon mchod 'bul byed pa ni der bkag pa med par shes par bya'o// gnyis pa theg pa chen po pha rol tu phyin pa ltar na/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi 'jug sgo ni/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems bskyed gyur na skad cig gis// 'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams// bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya ste// 'jig rten lha mir bcas pa'i phyag byar 'os// zhes gsungs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed pa la gsum ste/ sdom pa len pa dang*/ blangs nas lam la 'jug pa/ zhugs pa'i spyod pa la slob pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i gnas la skyo ba skyes nas/ myang 'das zhi ba'i bde la'ang ma zhen par mtha' gnyis spang ba'i byang chub kyi sems la spro ba'i gang zag gis/ yul khyad par can theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten nas/ rten khyad par can theg pa chen po'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song nas/ thabs khyad par can gyi sgo nas tshogs bsag cing sgrib pa sbyang ba la yan lag bdun pa dbul ba sngon du 'gro bas dngos gzhi smon pa dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed kyi sdom pa blang dgos pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/

byang sdom gyi dngos gzhi'i nyams len gyi gtso bo ni/ gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i smon pa dang*/ rgyu phyir lam la slob pa 'jug pa ste kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems so// don dam sems bskyed ni bsgom pa'i stobs kyi skye ba ste/ de rgyud la bskyed pa'i thabs la zhi gnas dang lhag mthong ste/ de'ang zhi gnas ni/ sems gnas pa'i thabs la brten nas mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog thams cad zhi ste sems kyi rang gdangs la 'jog cing gnas pa nyid yin la/ lhag mthong ni gzung 'dzin gyi sgrib g.yogs bsal nas/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin ma 'dres par so sor 'byed cing*/ gnyug ma skye med kyi rang zhal lhag gis mthong ba ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ yang dag gnas pa la brten nas// sems la sems ni 'jog phyir dang*// chos rab rnam par 'byed pa'i phyir// zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong brjod// ces bshad pa ltar dang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs kyis/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub sems// bdag dang phung po rnam rig gi /rtog pa rnams kyis ma bsgribs pa'i// rtag tu stong nyid mtshan nyid bshad// ces gsungs pa ltar te/ de ltar bden gnyis zung 'jug gi tshul gyis nyams su len pa ste/ de'ang sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba las/ kun rdzob ji ltar snang bzhin pas// don dam mtha' bzhi'i spros pa bral// zhes sogs rgya cher 'byung ba ltar/ 'dir bsang mchod kyang tha snyad kun rdzob tu mchod yul/ mchod bya/ mchod byed thams cad sgyu ma mkhan gyis sprul pa'i rta glang la sogs pa ltar snang yang don dam par rang bzhin spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i bden gnyis zung 'jug gi tshul du nyams su len dgos te/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa// bden pa gnyis la yang dag brten// 'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa dang*// dam pa'i don gyi bden pa'o// gang dag bden pa rnam gnyis kyi// rnam dbye rnam par mi shes pa// de dag sangs rgyas bstan pa yi// zab mo'i de nyid rtogs mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa la gnyis te/

yan lag bdun pa'i spyod pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi spyod pa'o// dang po ni/ sdom pa thob nas kyang thun mtshams sogs su'ang tshogs gsog pa'i yan lag bdun pa dbul dgos te/ de la 'bul ba'i tshig mi 'dra ba ci rigs pa 'byung yang*/ don la mi 'dra ba med de/ bzang spyod las/ me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang*// sil snyan rnams dang byug pa gdugs mchog dang*// mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi// zhes sogs dang*/ spyod 'jug las 'byung ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba'i yan lag bkar te dper brjod na/ me tog 'bras bu ji snyed yod pa dang*// sman gyi rnam pa gang dag yod pa dang*// 'jig rten rin chen ji snyed yod pa dang*// chu gtsang yid du 'ong ba ci yod dang*// rin chen ri bo dang ni de bzhin du// nags tshal sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' dang*// ljon shing me tog rgyan spras spud pa dang*// shing gang 'bras bzang yal ga dud pa dang*// lha sogs 'jig rten na yang dri dang ni// spos dang dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing*// ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog rnam pa dang*// mtsho dang rdzing du pad+mas brgyan pa dag /ngang pa shin tu skad snyan yid 'ong ldan// gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan rnams ni// nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mthas gtugs pa// yongs su bzung ba med pa de dag kun// blo yis blangs nas thub pa skyes kyi mchog /sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na// yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams kyis// bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes// zhes sogs dang*/ blos sprul pa'i mchod pa'ang*/ stong gsum kun du dri ngad ldang ba yi// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// thub dbang mchod gnas mchog la yid 'ong ba'i// me tog man dā ra dang pad+ma dang*// ut+pal la sogs dri zhim thams cad dang*// phreng ba spel legs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod// sgos mchog yid 'phrog dri ngad khyab pa yi// bdug pa'i sprin tshogs rnams kyang de la dbul// zhal zas bza' btung sna tshogs bcas pa yi// lha bshos rnams kyang de la dbul bar bgyi// gser gyi pad+ma tshar du dngar ba yi// rin chen sgron ma rnams kyang dbul bar bgyi// sa gzhi bstar ba spos kyis byugs pa der// me tog yid 'ong sil ma dgram par bgyi// gzhal med pho brang bstod dbyangs yid 'ong ldan// mu tig rin chen rgyan 'phyang mdzes 'bar ba// dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur de dag kun// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can la dbul bar bgyi// rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can// khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan// dbyibs legs lta na sdug pa bsgreng ba yang*// rtag tu thub dbang rnams la dbul bar bgyi// zhes sogs rgya cher 'byung ba ltar/

'dir bsang mchod bya ba dag gis kyang sngar nas skyabs 'gro'i sdom ldan du gyur pa'am/ bsang mchod la sogs pa'i dge tshogs stobs ldan gang bsgrub na'ang*/ sngon du skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro mi byed pa'i lugs med de/ 'gro mgon 'phags pas/ dkon mchog gsum la ma ltos pa'i// chos pa bzang yang mu stegs yin// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de'i steng du gzhan don du byang chub chen po 'dod pa'i sems mi bskyed pa'i theg pa chen po'i rigs can 'ga' yang med de/ gzhan don du sems bskyed pa med pa'i rgyal sras mi srid pa'i phyir/ des na rang gzhan gyi don du mchod yul rnams la dngos 'byor yid sprul gyi mchod sprin dpag tu med pas mnyes par byed dgos te/ rten theg pa chen po'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ba'i gang zag gis/ mchod yul de dag la brten pa'i tshogs bsags ci nus su bsgrub pa las lhag pa'i bsgrub bya gzhan ni 'ga' yang yod pa ma yin te/ ji skad du/ sdud pa las/ ji srid dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su ma rdzogs pa// de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni rtogs mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyal ba'i sras de'i spyod pa rang smin par byed pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug ste/ de'ang dgos pa la ltos nas grangs drug tu nges pa ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ longs spyod lus dang phun sum tshogs pa dang*// 'khor rtsom phun sum tshogs pa mngon mtho dang*// rtag tu nyon mongs dbang du mi 'gro dang*// bya ba rnams phyin ci ma log pa'o// zhes gsungs pa rang gzhan gyi don sgrub par chos drug dgos pas te/ sbyin pas longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ tshul khrims kyis mngon mtho'i lus/ bzod pas der yang gzugs bzang zhing 'khor mang du 'du/ brtson 'grus kyis rtsom pa/ bsam gtan gyis nyon mongs pa gnon pa/ shes rab kyis bya ba thams cad la ma rmongs pa'i phyir ro// sems can gzhan smin par byed pa la bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi ste/

mdo sde rgyan las/ sbyin mtshungs de ston len 'jug dang*// bdag nyid rjes su 'jug rnams kyis// snyan par smra dang don spyod dang*// don mthun nyid du 'dod pa yin// zhes pa ltar te/ der yang dgos par ltos nas grangs bzhir nges pa'ang*// phan par byed pa'i thabs dang ni// 'dzin dang 'jug par byed pa dang*// de bzhin rjes su 'jug byed pas// bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhir bshad do// zhes pa ste/ gdul bya la gnas skabs su phan par bya ba'i zang zing dang*/ mthar thug gi phan pa'i rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi tshig 'dzin pa dang*/ de'i don la rang nyid 'jug pa dang*/ don de la yang nas yang du bsnun te rjes su 'jug par bya ba'i phyir bzhir nges par gsungs pa'i phyir ro// des na rang re sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa theg pa chen po 'dir zhugs pas kyang*/ lus dang longs spyod dge ba'i dngos po thams cad sems can gyi don du bla na med pa'i byang chub chen po thob pa'i phyir/ dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa'i yo byad du byas nas mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ sbyin pa la sogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi spyod pa spyad pa ste/ de dag gis tshogs gnyis bsags pa la brten nas lam gyi mngon par rtogs pas rim gyis yon tan rgyud la bskyed de/ mngon par byang chub pa dang mya ngan las 'das pa chen po ston pa'i bar sgrub par byed de/ ji skad du/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rigs dang chos la mos pa dang*// de bzhin du ni sems bskyed dang*// sbyin la sogs pa bsgrub pa dang*// skyon med pa dag 'jug pa dang*// sems can yongs su smin byed dang*// zhing ni rnam par sbyong ba dang*// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa dang*// byang chub mchog dang ston pa'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar mos pas spyod pa'i sa dang*/ skyon med pa la 'jug pa zhes bya ba nas sa rnams rim gyis bgrod de mchog gi gnas su phyin par byed par byed pas na pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya'o// de lta bu'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi don rtogs pa dag gis/

bsang mchod 'bul ba la sogs pa dge tshogs gang bsgrubs kyang byang chub kyi spyod pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug ldan du mi 'gyur ba ni 'ga' yang yod pa ma yin te/ ji ltar zhe na/ bsang mchod stobs pa nyid la mtshon na/ mchod sbyin gyi yul 'khor 'das rab 'byams gang dag mchis pa la so sor 'os pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad gya nom pas dgyes shing tshim par byed pa ni sbyin pa/ dri zhim pa'i spos kyi rigs dang lha shing bzang po bsregs pa'i dud sprin gyi phung pos bsang zhing gtsang bar byed pa dang*/ shin tu dag par bsang bar byed pa'i thabs khyad par du gyur pa'i mchod pa 'di dag gis/ bla na med pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa rnams la mchod pa phul ba'i mthu la brten nas/ yul de dag sngar las mchog dang phul du dbyung ba med mod/ dper na sku khrus gsol ba na'ang*/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i lus sems sdug bsngal bsal slad du// chu gtsang sman spos 'dag chal 'dis bgos pas// bdag cag dam pa'i sku mchog thob par shog /ces dang*/ gzhan yang*/ stong gsum kun du dri mchog 'byung 'gyur ba'i// spos mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// zhes yul mchog la mchod pa phul bas/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib/ nad gdon/ dme grib/ btsog grib/ nyams grib/ ro grib/ 'khon grib/ sde 'khrugs kyi nyes pas phog pa thams cad sbyong ba dang*/ rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba ni/ mi dge ba bcu spyad pa/ bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba ni so thar ris bdun/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang*/ rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa dam tshig gi tshogs la nyes ltung byung ba thams cad dag byed kyi cho gar 'gyur ba ni tshul khrims/ dkon mchog gsum la mchod pas mnyes pa la brten nas tshogs gnyis sgrub pa la dka' spyad bzod pa dang 'jig rten pa'i lha 'dre la sogs pa rang la gnod 'tsher byed pa rnams la'ang lan du mi khro bar de dag gi re ba 'gengs par byed pa ni bzod pa/

sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas mgron rigs rnams dgyes pa'i phyir bsang mchod kyi las la 'bad rtsol byed pa ni brtson 'grus/ kun rdzob tu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mchod yul mchod pa'i yo byad/ mchod 'bul byed pa rnams tshul bzhin du dmigs nas mchod pa la rtse gcig tu sems 'dzin pa ni bsam gtan/ mchod bya/ mchod byed/ mchod yul te 'khor gsum du rnam par mi rtog pa sgyu ma'i snang ba ltar snang tsam rang bzhin gyis grub pa med par shes pa ni shes rab ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug ldan 'gyur bas tshogs gnyis zung 'jug tu bsgrubs pas srid zhi'i pha rol tu phyin par byed pa'i rgyur mi 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir ro// des na gzhi spong ba pha rol phyin pa'i lugs la rang nyid kyis 'dod pa'i yon tan sred zhen mi bskyed pa'i ched du spang ba las/ dkon mchog mchod pa la sogs pa'i tshogs gnyis sgrub pa'i thabs la med thabs med pa nyid do// gnyis pa gzhi mi spong ba theg chen thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i lugs la/ de lta bu'i theg pa thun mong ba'i lam gyis rgyud legs par sbyangs nas/ thun mong ma yin pa sngags kyi theg par 'jug pa la bzhi ste/ sngags kyi sdom pa len pa/ blangs nas lam la 'jug pa/ zhugs pa'i spyod par slob pa/ skabs don dpyad pa'o// dang po ni/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma las/ rgyud sde bzhi po rang rang gi lugs kyi dbang bskur ba thob nas so so'i lam la slob pa'i skal ldan du gyur pa dang*/ khyad par rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bzhi rdzogs par blangs nas dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin pa nyid do// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gzhi de dag mi spong ba'i 'thad pa/ mi spong ba'i thabs/ des grol ba'i tshul lo// dang po gzhi ni sngar bstan pa'i yul nyid yin la/ de dag gang zag kun nas dkris pa shas che ba rnams yul la brten pa'i phyin ci log gi rnam par rtog pas 'ching bar byed kyi/

ngo bo nyid kyis 'ching bar byed pa ma yin no// des na 'ching ba'i rgyu thabs dang bcas pas yul rnams grol ba'i rkyen du 'gyur ba yin te/ kye rdo rje las/ skye bo mi bzad pa yi las// gang dang gang gis 'ching 'gyur ba// thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis// srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ der thabs la mkhas pa ji ltar zhe na/ 'dod khams pa'i sems can 'dod pa'i longs spyod spong mi nus pa rnams de dag gi spyod pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i spyod pa bstan dgos pas/ des de dag 'jug par 'gyur la/ zhugs pa na de dag thabs la mkhas pa'i rtsis bsgyur nas bla na med pa'i byang chub tu dwang ba'i phyir rgyud sde bzhi gsungs te/ ji skad du/ saṃ pu ṭi las/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcang dang*// dgod dang bltas pa 'khrig pa yi// srin bu'i tshul gyis rgyud bzhir gnas// zhes gsungs/ der ma zad rig byed pa dag 'jug tshul bzhi yod pa/ de dag rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ de dag gi spyod pa dang rjes su mthun par bstan pa'i rgyud sde bzhir gsungs te/ de'ang 'dod chags chos su smra ba'i rigs can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud gsungs te/ bde mchog las/ sgyu ma dag ni thams cad las// bud med sgyu ma khyad par 'phags// zhes so// 'tshe ba chos su smra ba'i rigs can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir spyod pa'i rgyud bstan te/ khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa las/ bcom ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid ni// khro bo'i ming ni gshin rje'i gshed// de mthong nas ni khro bo gzhan// thams cad thams cad lag cha shor// zhes dang*/ de nas gang gis langs pa las// mtshon cha rnon po 'phyar ba yis// bsad pa'i sha dang khrag bcas pa'i// ar+gha de la dbul bar bya// zhes so// yang gtsang sbra chos su smra ba'i rigs can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir bya ba'i rgyud gsungs te/

legs par grub pa las/ ngas ni sngags pas kha zas dkar gsum dang*// rtsa ba sdong bu 'bras bu tshod ma dang*// 'bru mar tshig ma dar ba 'ol skon dang*// thug pa rnams ni bza' btung yin par gsungs// zhes dang*/ dus su zos nas dus su khrus byas nas// phreng ba mar me bdug pa bstod dang dri// sha chang med pa'i lha bshos phul nas su// ku sha'i gdan la 'dug la bzlas brjod brtsam// zhes bya ba la sogs gtsang sbra'i spyod pa dang*/ khrus bya ba dang*/ sbyin sreg bya ba la sogs pa'ang de dag gi spyod pa dang mthun par bstan pa'i phyir yang*/ gsum ga chos su smra ba'i rigs can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsungs te/ de nyid 'dus par 'dod khro gti mug spyod pa ma nges pa rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ lha rnams rjes su chags pa dang khro ba dang zhi ba dang sna tshogs pa'i nyams dang ldan par gsungs par sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis bzhed pa ltar ro// des na gdul bya so so'i mos pa mkhyen nas de dang mthun par chos bstan zhes bya ba'i don to// gnyis pa 'ching ba'i rgyu rang gi phung khams skye mched nas brtsams te/ ci dang ci snang ba'i yul dang yul can rnams/ rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i rnam rol du shes par byas nas longs spyod pa ste/ de'ang bskyed pa'i rim pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i dbang du byas na/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad ni// ci 'dod par ni bstan bya ste// rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis// bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya// zhes dang*/ kye rdo rje las/ gzugs la gau rīr rab tu grags// sgra yi cha la tsau rī ste// dri yi cha la ro langs ma// zhes sogs rgyud sde rnams las rgya cher 'byung ba'i phyir/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i dbang du byas na/ 'ching ba'i rgyu ni rnam par rtog pa yin la/ de'ang thabs gang la brten nas/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skyes pa dang*/

des yul rnams kha dog bsgyur te longs spyod pas 'ching ba thams cad rim gyis 'grol bar 'gyur te/ 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ thabs dang shes rab las byung ba'i// rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sbyor ba yis// phung po khams dang skye mched gzugs// sngags pas sbyor ba nges byas la// zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ gsum pa 'khor bar 'ching ba'i rgyu ni/ tha mal gyi rnam par rtog pa yin la/ de la brten nas nyon mongs pa rim gyis skye ba'i phyir/ de bas na thabs gnyis pos/ rgyu rang gi ngo bo de bsal nas yul rnams kha dog bsgyur bas/ slar gnyen po'am grogs su byed par 'gyur te/ kye rdo rje las/ dag pas dug med byas nas ni// bstan bya 'di dag bsten pa nyid// ces dang*/ rdo rje gur las/ 'dod chags kyis bskyed 'jig rten pa// 'dod chags nyid kyis rnam grol 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa ni/ des na mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ spyod lam gyi skabs thams cad nas yul dang yul can thams cad lha'i 'khor lor shes par byas nas phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mnyes par byas te mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub par byed pa dang*/ de bzhin du dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa la sogs pa/ sngags kyi spyod pa thams cad la/ phyi nang gsang ba'i dkon mchog gsum mam/ de dag thams cad kyi rang bzhin bla ma dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs su shes par byas nas skyabs kyi gtso bor bzung ba dang*/ de dag las legs par thob pa'i dam tshig sdom pa'i tshogs rnams srog ltar gces par bsrung ba dang*/ de dag tshul bzhin mnyes pa las tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho lta bur rdzogs par byed cing sa lam gyi yon tan rgyud la bskyed de/ mchog gi dngos grub kyi bar thams cad gsang sngags kyi spyod pa spyad dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ mchod pa de dag la'ang phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa rnams te/

de dag mchod pa'i cho ga mi 'dra ba du ma dang*/ mchod pa'i bye brag dang*/ 'bul ba'i tshig tshigs bcad dang*/ lhug pa'i rigs mi 'dra ba rgyud dang rgyud 'grel rnams nas dpag tu med pa 'byung ste de dag tu rtogs par bya ba las smos kyis ga la longs/ 'on kyang 'dir bsang mchod kyi byung khungs kyi shes byed bstan pa'i phyir phyi mchod dang*/ 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa'i bye brag las brtsams pa'i tshul cung zang bsnyad na/ 'phags yul rnams su mchod yul dang mi chen gyi rigs spyan 'dren pa na/ phyogs kun du dri zhim gyis chag chag 'debs shing dag byed kyi bsang chus 'thor ba dang*/ zhabs bkru ba'i chus zhabs bkru ba dang*/ bza' btung gi sngon du zhal bkru ba sogs byed pa'i lugs yod pa ltar/ 'dir dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa 'bul ba'ang 'jig rten pa dang go bstun gyi tshul gyis nyer spyod 'bul ba yod de/ de'ang zhabs bsil gyis ni zhabs bkru ba'i yo byad dang*/ zhal bsil gyis zhal bshal ba dang*/ dri zhim gyi chu'i 'thor 'thung dang bsang gtor gyi sku dang sa phyogs kun du 'thor ba dang*/ khrus kyi rdzing bus chu gtsang sman spos 'dag chal gyi khrus gsol ba ste/ de dag gi bkur stis ri mor bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ rang nyid tshe rabs kun du lus la dri med cing kun gyi yid du 'ong ba dang*/ rang bzhin dang bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba'i nyes pas mi gos par 'gyur ba la sogs pa rnams so// mchod pa'i dngos gzhi yon chab bam mchod yon dri zhim gyis sbags pa/ yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu gtsang gi rdzing bu me tog dang pad+ma dang ngang pas brgyan pa rnams 'bul ba ni btung ba'i mchod pa'o// me tog gi rigs chu las skyes pa/ thang las skyes pa/ me tog man+dā ra ba dang*/ puṇ+ḍi rī ka ut+pa la sogs me tog gi rigs kyi phreng ba/ 'phyang 'phrul me tog gi bla re gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/

khang bzang dang*/ khang bzang gi rgyan phreng*/ me tog dang pad+ma bzhad pa'i tshal ji snyed 'bul ba rnams dang*/ gzhan yang rin po che'i rgyan phreng sogs nas sgeg mdzes byed pa'i rgyan phreng rnams ni me tog gi mchod pa dang*/ byug pa dang spos kyi bye brag ga pur/ tsan+dan dkar dmar/ spos dkar/ bzang drug la sogs pa'i sman dang*/ dri zhim pa a ga ru dang mkhan dkar shug pa la sogs pa lhan skyes kyi spos dang*/ sbyar ba'i spos rigs ji snyed bsregs pa'i dud sprin gyi ngad pas bdugs shing bsang ba dang*/ gzhan yang dri zhim spos kyi chus lus la byug pa dang khrus byed pa rnams kyis bsang zhing dag par byed pa ni/ byug pa dang spos kyi mchod pa dang*/ sgrib pa'i mun pa sel bar byed pa'i sgron ma mar me dang*/ 'bru mar gyi mar me/ rtswa dang shing dang 'dam bu 'od ma'i sgron ma dang*/ rin po che dang nor bu'i sgron ma/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ me long la sogs pa'i mar me'i mchod pa dang*/ dri chab bam dri'i byug pa ni lus kyi dri ma ngan pa bsal ba dang*/ tsha bas gdung ba bsil ba dang lus reg na tshim pa'i bde ba ster bar byed pa ni dri chab kyi mchod pa dang*/ lus brtas par byed pa lha dang mi'i kha zas pa'i bza' ba dang*/ bca' ba bzang po kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i lha bshos dang*/ gtor ma rgyan gyis brgyan pa ji ltar 'byor pas mchod pa ni zhal zas kyi mchod pa dang*/ snyan cing 'jebs pa'i rol mo'i bye brag sgra brnyan/ gling bu/ sil snyan/ rnga dang rdza rnga/ rnga zlum pa sogs pa dang*/ sgra don gab tshig sogs rgyan gyi lam nas drangs pa'i bstod dbyangs snyan brjid rnams kyis mchod pa ni rol mo'i mchod pa ste/ nye bar spyad pa'i 'os su gyur pas nyer spyod kyi mchod pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ni 'jig rten khams kyi phyogs bcu dus gsum kun na kha dog dang dbyibs kyis bsdus pa'i gzugs dang skye mched mdzes shing lta bas chog mi shes pa la/

slar yang dar dang rin po che dang me tog phreng ba la sogs sgeg byed rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i gzugs mchog ji snyed pa blos blangs nas 'bul ba ni gzugs kyi mchod pa dang*/ sgra dang dri ro rnams gong du bstan pa ltar dang*/ reg bya'i yon tan srab 'jam yang ba/ dwangs shing sgrib med pa dū ku la dang*/ kā shi ka dang ka tsi lin+da la sogs pa'i lha'i gos bzang kha dog bzang shing mdzes pa/ lus la reg na dro 'jam bde ba phun sum tshogs pa bskyed pa'i bgo ba ji snyed yod pa blos 'bul ba reg bya'i mchod pa ste/ phyi'i mchod pa dper mtshon tsam yin la/ mchod yon la sogs pa de dag phul bas rtag tu gzugs mdzes shing lus la tsan+dan gyi dri bro dang tshul khrims rnam par dag par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i phan yon mang du bshad pa yod kyang 'dir ma spros so// de ltar na 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i lugs la/ 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad lam du byed pa'i sgo nas bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dbyer med par mnyes par byed pas bskal pa grangs med mang por bsgrub bya'i tshogs kyang mthong ba'i chos 'dir rdzogs par byed pa ste/ ji skad du/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ chags can ye shes 'dod pa yis// rtag tu 'dod yon lnga rnams bsten// zhes sogs rgya cher 'byung ste/ de rnams kyis bsang mchod kyi cho ga dngos shugs las bstan pa'i tshul gyis byung khungs ci rigs par bstan zin to// spyi don gnyis pa bsang mchod kyi rnam par gzhag pa la gsum ste/ lugs srol gang du gtogs ngos gzung ba/ de la rnam par dpyad pa/ bsang mchod kyi cho ga dngos so// dang po ni/ gong du bstan pa ltar bsang mchod 'di dag ni/ thabs kyis ma zin pa dang*/ zin pa phyi nang gi grub mtha' kun du ming 'dogs dmigs bsal gyis mthon pa ma gtogs pa/ bsang mchod dbul yul 'khor 'das mgron rigs/ bsam pa rang gzhan phan 'dod/ dngos po 'dod pa'i yon tan rnams thog ma nyid nas grub pa dang*/

bye brag tu skabs su bab pa bsang mchod kyi cho ga nyid ni mdo sngags thun mong ba'i tshogs bsags yin la/ khyad par sngags kyi cho ga'i bdag mdun gyi tshul du bsgrubs nas mchod pa ste/ de'ang rgyud sde bzhi char nas bstan pa'i lha'i rnam pa rjes su chags pa dang khro ba dang zhi ba dang sna tshogs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'i tshul du yod pas de nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa rnal 'byor rgyud dam/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang mthun par bsdebs pa'i cho gar gzung du btub ste/ rnal 'byor gong ma'i 'og tu gzhan gsum po thams cad chud dgos pa'i phyir/ de'ang ji ltar zhe na/ tshul 'di ni/ gzhan du bla ma dang yi dam rnams kyi mchod pa'i cho ga dang*/ maṇ+ḍal mchod pa'i cho ga dang*/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ chab gtor sogs mchod sbyin gtor ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ sreg blugs kyi rnal 'byor gsur bsngo la sogs pa dang mtshungs par mchod sbyin gyi cho ga don la tshogs gnyis gsog pa'i thabs khyad par ba nyid do// gnyis pa ni/ kha cig bsang mchod 'di g.yung drung bon gyi lugs yin zhes smra ste/ spyir bod yul 'dir sngar bon po'i lugs srol dar che ba byung bas/ gas sa mkhar dang bong so brtsigs pa sogs thor bur 'dres pa yod 'gro rang*/ bsang gzhung 'di la bon gyi ston pa dang rig 'dzin brgyud pa/ bon lha gtso bor byas pa ci yang ma mthong bas bon lugs yin pa'i shes byed med cing*/ gzhi bdag bon ri yin zhes pa lta bu smra ba tsam gyis de'i lugs su mi 'gro ste/ 'jig rten pa'i mgron rigs mchod pa la ban bon so sor dbyer med pa'i phyir/ gcig tu na bon lugs yin du chug kyang*/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas brtsams te rang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar brgyud pa bar ma chad pa las byung ba'i lam srol/ skyabs yul du bla med dkon mchog gsum gzung*/ lta ba mtha' bral dbu ma dang mthun/

sgom pa byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel gyi rnal 'byor/ spyod pa mdo sngags lugs kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho lta bur spyad pa rnams yod na/ bon po'am mu stegs byed kyi lugs su btags pa gang yin yang thal sbyar gyis btud pa'i 'os su gyur te/ dper na rgya gar du slob dpon pha khol dang*/ bod 'dir yang rong ston shes bya kun rig sogs kyang dang por mu stegs dang bon po yin yang phyi nas sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snang byed chen por gyur pa lta bu'o// 'ga' zhig bsang gzhung rgya gar nas bod du 'gyur ba med pas/ 'di nyid slob dpon pad+mas bsang brngan gyi gzhung mdzad pas de nyid nas dar ba yin no zhe na/ bod kyi lha srin dregs pa can dang gzhi bdag la sogs pa dmigs bsal dgos pa rnams ma gtogs bsang mchod 'bul ba'i srol de sngon chad 'phags pa'i yul gru gang du'ang ma byung ba'i mchod pa'i cho ga zhig mdzad pa'ang mi rigs la/ gcig tu de phan chad 'khor ba na yul 'dod pa lngar yul can gyis longs su spyad mi dgos pa'i chags bral du gyur pa'am/ chags bral du ma gyur kyang dbang don so sor 'brel med du gnas par gyur pa gang yin/ de'i tshe skyes bu dam pa rnams kyang yul can yul la longs spyad pa na/ de dag dge sbyor gyi rtsis ma zin par lung ma bstan nam btang snyoms su lus pa gang yin smra dgos pa'i phyir/ gal te bon po'i lugs srol nyid yin te de'i bsang gzhung zhig la gzhir byas nas slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa yin no zhe na/ skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum gzung ba sogs snga mar mtshungs so// des na rang lugs rgya gar nas bod du 'gyur ba'i bsang mchod kyi gzhung da lta'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi khrod na zur bkol zhig bzhugs pa ma mngon na'ang*/ med pa kho na khas 'che byar mi btub ste/ bod kyi yul du ma 'gyur ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos mang du yod tshul gsungs pa'i phyir/

des na bsang mchod cho ga rgya gzhung nas zur bkol ma byung ba tsam ma gtogs par/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen rnams su nye bar spyod pa'i skabs nas bdug spos kyi mchod pa dang*/ 'dod yon lnga'i skabs nas dri'i mchod pa ste/ de'ang mchod 'bul tshigs su bcad pa spyod 'jug las/ spos mchog yid 'phrog dri ngad khyab pa yi// bdug pa'i sprin tshogs rnams kyang de la 'bul// zhes dang*/ phyogs dus kun na tsan+dan sbrul snying dang*// a gar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed pa// zhes dang*/ ga pur a ga ra dzā ti la sogs pa// legs par sbyar ba las byung dri yi tshogs// rnam gsum dri yi rdo rje mar byas nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la dbul bar bgyi// zhes bya ba la sogs pa gong du smos ltar 'byung ba'i phyi'i mchod pa de rnams las/ slob dpon pad+ma la sogs pa mkhas grub rnams kyis bsang mchod kyi cho ga zur du bkar ba'i tshogs bsags khyad par ba byas pa zhig tu khas blangs dgos so// gnyis pa ni/ bsang mchod 'di gtso bor dag byed dang gtsang byed dri zhim bdug pa'i sprin gyi mchod pas tshogs gsog pa'i thabs bla na med pa ste/ ji ltar zhe na/ gong du smos pa'i nyer spyod pa rnams dang*/ 'dod yon lnga la sogs pa dngos su bshams pa'i mchod gtor spyan gzigs la sogs pa dang*/ bsang gi dud sprin gyi kha dog bzang zhing dwangs gsal sgrib pa med pa dang*/ dud sprin 'phro 'du'i dbyibs kyi khyad par skad cig re la'ang gzugs dbyibs sna tshogs ston par byed pas gzugs kyi mchod pa dang*/ bsang mchod kyi cho ga la ming tshig yi ge 'dus pa'i rjod byed tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ rnga dung*/ sil snyan/ gling bu la sogs pa sgra dbyangs phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas sgra dbyangs kyi mchod pa dang*/ dri zhim phun sum tshogs pas dbang po kun nas tshim par byed pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas dri'i mchod pa/

bsang rdzas la dkar gsum mngar gsum ja chang zas mchog gi bye brag dpag tu med pa bsregs pas ro bcud nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pas ro'i mchod pa ste/ dper na sbyin sreg gi rdzas la bza' bca'i bye brag mang du bsreg pa lta bu dang*/ bsang mchod kyi rgyu la sman spos bye brag ji snyed bsregs pa'i dri ngad kyi lus dang dbang po'i sgo rnams su reg pa tsam gyi lus dang dbang po tshim zhing bde ba ster ba'i reg pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas reg bya'i mchod pa ste 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par 'gyur ba rnams ni dngos su bshams pa'i yon tan dang*/ mchod 'bul byed pa po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis/ dud sprin dang 'od zer gyi rtse mo re re las kyang nyer spyod 'dod yon la sogs pa mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba phrag gi rgyas par 'gengs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad byang chub sems dpa' kun du bzang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i rjes su 'gro bas mchod cing*/ de dag kyang 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyi dbul bar byed pa yin no// mdor na skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum gtso bor bzhugs pa'i yon tan gyi zhing dpag tu med pa rnams la mchod pa'i khyad par mang pos bsti stang dang*/ bla mar byed pa dang ri mor byed pa dang*/ rjed par byed pa dang*/ phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ bsngags pa brjod pas gsol ba 'debs pa rnams kyis/ gnas skabs mthar thug kun du bslu ba ci zhig ste/ phal po che las/ rigs par brtson pa dkon mchog gsum rnams la// sbyor ba skyo ba med pas mchod byas na// de dag bdud bzhi'i lam las rab 'das te// byang chub bla med myur du reg par 'gyur// zhes sogs rgya cher 'byung ba las rtogs par bya'o// de bzhin du snying rje'i sems dang ldan pas 'jig rten pa'i lha klu 'byung por gtogs pa la sogs pa'i sde brgyad dang*/

sa bdag gzhi bdag lam lha/ dgra lha 'go ba'i lha la sogs phan gnod byed por btags pa rnams la mchod sbyin byas pas/ rang nyid kyi sbyin pa rnam pa bzhi'i pha rol tu phyin par 'gyur ba dang*/ gnas skabs su rang gzhan gyis dngos dang brgyud nas de dag la phog thug tu 'gyur ba'i dme 'khrug thab gzhob la sogs pa bya byed nongs pa'i nyes pas gos pa thams cad bsang zhing sbyong bar byed pa dang*/ de dag rang rang 'dod pa'i dngos po de dang des dgyes shing tshim par gyur nas gnod pa dang gdug pa'i bsam sbyor thams cad zhi ba dang*/ rang rang so so'i nus mthu gang yod kyi sgo nas sems can gyi khams su bde zhing skyid pa dang*/ lo legs pa la sogs pa'i dpal kun 'phel ba'i stong grogs byed par 'gyur bas/ sems can la phan bde rgya chen po 'byung ba'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa la sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ bsang mchod 'di'i gtor ma la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ rgyas par dgos pa'i gtor ma ni/ de'i sbyor ba snod gtsang du// zan leb zlum po rim gsum steng*// dbus su dkon mchog spyi'i zlum gtor// g.yas g.yon chos skyong gzhi bdag gtor// bang rim bar par zur gsum dang*// zur bzhi zur lnga gcus gtor gnyis// sman zhal stod smad zur gsum bzhi// bdud mkhar zlum po 'dab gsum pa// 'brang chung gling bzhi'i gzugs dbyibs can// bang rim 'og mar rgyal srid bdun// bkra shis brgyad sogs mchod pa'i phreng*// khyung 'brug seng ge g.yag lug sogs// 'bring dbus dkon mchog spyi gtor la// phyogs mtshams g.yag lug ra sha ba// gna' ba dgo ba gnyen bse ru// mtha' skor kun du mtheb kyu dang*// zan ril chang skrad bdun re bskor// bsdus par nyer spyod phye mar tsam// gzhan yang phye mar ja sogs dang*// shing rtsi smin gyi dud pa btang*// zhes pa ltar te/

de dag gi dmigs bsal ni/ dbus kyi zlum gtor bla ma dkon mchog spyi'i gtor ma/ g.yas kyi zlum gtor chos skyong dang g.yon gyi dkar gtor gzhi bdag spyi'i 'o// zur gsum pa ni gnyan dang btsan gyi rigs dang*/ zur bzhi pa ni rgyal po'i rigs/ zur lnga pa ni the'u rang rigs/ gcus gtor gnyis ni ma mo dang dam sri'i rigs/ sman zhal ni sman gyi rigs/ stod zur gsum smad zur bzhi pa gza'i rigs/ bdud mkhar bshos zlum mtheb kyus bskor ba ni klu dang sa bdag rigs/ 'brang chung ni lha'i rigs/ smad gling bzhi'i dbyibs la stod mi gzugs can ni de dag nas 'ongs pa'i gnod sbyin gyi rigs/ gnyis pa 'bring po dkon mchog spyi la zlum gtor dang*/ zan ril chang bu mtheb kyu rnams ni de dag tu mthus pa'i mgron rigs rnams kyi'o// gzhan rnams ni mchod rdzas dang spyan gzigs dkor nor rnams so// gzhan yang ja dkar chang phud/ shing rtsi sman spos sna tshogs kyi dud sprin btang ba dang*/ nyer spyod phye mar mda' dar ba dan sogs kyang bsham mo// gnyis pa ni/ dngos gzhir bdag bskyed spyan drangs mchod// phrin las zhu zhing phywa g.yang dgug /ces pa ltar lnga las/ dang po bdag bskyed pa la gnyis/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'o// dang po la gnyis te/ byin gyis brlab pa/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed do// dang po ni/ mchod gtor rnams la dmigs te sngags drug phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod gtor rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rgya cher spel ba ni byin gyis brlab pa'o// gnyis pa ni yi dam lha rang gang mos kyi rnal 'byor gyi nga rgyal la gnas pas chog mod/ 'dir bsil ldan ljongs kyi mgon po spyan ras gzigs byed pa kun la khyab che ba'i dbang du byas te/ de'ang mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi tshogs bzhugs pa la bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis skyabs su 'gro ba ni skyabs 'gro dang*/

sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir/ mchod sbyin bsang gi mchod pa la 'jug par bgyi'o snyam pa ni sems bskyed do// gnyis pa ni/ swa bhā wa'i sngags don ltar chos thams cad stong nyid du bsgom pas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags te/ de'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hrīḥlas 'phags pa thugs rje chen po phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa'am phyag bzhi pa gang rung rgyan dang cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'i spyi bor rigs bdag 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan dang bcas par gsal btab la/ thugs kar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang bcas nas/ yi ge drug pa'i bzlas pa ci nus bya ba ni bdag bskyed pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa'i mgron rigs thams cad steng nas byon pa rnams kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa lta bu/ 'og nas byon pa rnams dbyar gyi sa rlangs rdol ba lta bu/ bar nas byon pa rnams dge 'dun mang po chos 'khor la 'du ba lta bur skad cig gis byon par bsams pa ni spyan drang ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang yi dam lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas sras slob bcas pa'i tshogs bzhugs pa dang*/ de'i 'og rol du bka' srung chos skyong nor lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba sa bdag gzhi bdag dgra lha lam lha la sogs pa'i mchod sbyin bya bar 'os pa'i mgron rigs thams cad rang rang gi gzugs dang cha lugs kyi rnam pa can gyis so sor 'os pa'i gdan la dgyes bzhin du bzhugs par bsams pa ni bzhugs su gsol ba'o// gsum pa mchod pa la gsum ste/ 'dod dgu dbul ba'i mchod pa/ nyams grib sbyong ba'i bsang mchod/ bshags pa 'bul ba'i mchod pa'o// dang por bden pa'i stobs brjod pas so sor thob pa'i phyir bsngos nas/

bye brag tu dngos 'byor yid sprul gyi mchod sprin nye bar spyod pa bdun dang*/ 'don yon lnga dang*/ rgyal srid bdun/ bkra shis rtags brgyad la sogs pa lha mi'i yul gyi 'dod yon longs spyod dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'bul ba yin no// gnyis pa ni/ khyad par dri zhim spos kyi khyad par lhan cig skyes pa dang*/ sbyor ba'i spos dang shing rtsi bzang po sna tshogs dang*/ dkar mngar phye mar 'bru rigs la sogs pa'i 'dod yon bza' bca'i rigs gang 'byor dang lhan cig bsregs pa'i dri bsung sprin gyi phung po kha dog phun sum tshogs pa bltas pas tshim pa/ dri phun sum tshogs pa bsnam pas tshim pa/ ro phun sum tshogs pa myong bas tshim pa/ nus pa phun sum tshogs pa srid zhi'i mgron so sor gang 'dod pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa'i dpal gyis re ba thams cad yongs su 'gengs par nus pa'i rang bzhin can gyi mchod sprin/ sangs rgyas zhing rab 'byams rgyas par 'gengs shing*/ dud sprin dang 'od zer gyi rtse mo re re las kyang 'phags pa kun du bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul gyis 'byung ba de lta bu gyur par bsams la/ mchod pa'i khyad par de dag phul bas bla na med pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba mi zad yon tan nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang du 'byor ba'i rgyal ba sras slob srung ma'i tshul bstan pa rnams ni bgres rgud phongs pa'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag la ring du 'das pa'i phyir dgyes par bskyed du ma mchis mod/ sems can rnams kyi sgo gsum bya byed dang bcas pa'i nyes ltung sgrib pa'i grib dang dri ma thams cad sbyang ba'i phyir dang*/ bla na med pa byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'i tshogs gnyis rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ bsam don gang dang gang yin pa'i re ba de dang des bskang ba'i phyir/ mchod pa'i khyad par de dang de shin tu dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes shing rol ba dang*/

tshim pa'i tshul gyis bzhes par mdzad pa yin pas de ltar du gyur song snyam pa dang*/ 'jig rten par gtogs pa'i mgron rigs rnams kyang bsang mchod phul ba la brten nas/ dbang po lnga'i spyod yul du 'dod pa'i longs spyod gya nom pa 'dzad pa med pa'i gter la dbang 'byor ba'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur nas thams cad dgyes dgur rtsen pas tshim zhing re ba thams cad rdzogs pa dang*/ gnod pa dang gdug pa'i bsam pa can rnams kyang zhi zhing dga' mgu rangs pa'i sems dang ldan par gyur te/ thams cad kyis rang rang la mthu nus gang yod kyi ngos nas rtag tu phan 'dogs dang bsam don sgrub pa'i stong grogs mdzad pa la mngon par phyogs par bsam mo// de dag kyang don dam par mchod yul/ mchod bya/ mchod byed/ thams cad kyi rang bzhin yod med yin min/ gcig dang du ma la sogs pa spros bral sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med du nyams su len pa ni bsang mchod 'bul ba yin no// gsum pa ni/ rang dang sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas pa'i sgo gsum gyi sdig pa dang sdom pa dang dam tshig gi nyes ltung gang dag byung ba rnams yul dkon mchog gsum gyi spyan sngar 'gyod cing phyin chad bsdam pa dang*/ de ltar byas pas nyes pa thams cad dag nges snyam pa ste/ stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bsang ba dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i lha srin sde brgyad du gtogs pa rnams zhe 'khon phog thug tu 'gyur ba'i las byas pa dang*/ dme 'khrugs la sogs pa nyes grib kyis phog pa rnams kyang dag byed bsang gi mchod pas thams cad sor chud de zhi bde'i rnam par gnas song snyam pa ni nyams grib bsang ba'o// bzhi pa ni/ de ltar bsang mchod phul ba'i mthu la brten nas/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams mnyes nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsol ba dang*/ bka' srung dregs pa'i sde tshogs rnams mnyes nas chos sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi ba la sogs pa gang bsgo ba'i phrin las thams cad sgrub pa dang*/

nor lha'i tshogs mnyes nas chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol ba dang*/ gzhi bdag yul bdag dgra lha la sogs pa mnyes nas rtag tu kha 'dzin rgyab brten byed pa dang*/ de dag thams cad kyis thun mong du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ 'jig rten khams su bde legs dang dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*/ khyad par sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen sel zhing*/ mthun rkyen bsam don sgrub pa'i las la bskul ba rnams ni phrin las zhu ba'o// lnga pa ni/ de nas grogs sam sbyin bdag gi mda' dar dang phye mar thogs su bcug la/ rang gis phywa g.yang gyer ba'i tshe/ de ltar bsang mchod phul bas dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang*/ bdag gis bsang mchod phul ba'i bsam sbyor dge ba'i mthus/ 'jig rten snod bcud kyi dge legs dang chos dang srid pas bsdus pa'i sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad khab len rdo dang phrad pa'i lcags phye g.yo ba ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad nas/ bsang mchod kyi gnas 'dir rang dbang med par tshur 'du bar bsams la gyer ba ni phywa g.yang len pa ste dngos gzhi'o// gsum pa la/ rjes ni bzod gsol gshegs su gsol// bkra shis bsngo ba'i rgyas gdab bo// zhes pa ltar gsum ste/ dang po ni cho ga'i skabs kyi nongs pa bshags pa'i tshig gang rung re brjod pa ni bzod par gsol ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron rnams shin tu dgyes shing tshim pa'i tshul gyis rang gnas su gshegs par bsams la gshegs gsol gyi tshig gang yang rung ba re brjod pa ni gshegs su gsol ba'o// gsum pa ni/ bkra shis kyi me tog thogs te 'thor ba dang bcas pas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa ci rigs par brjod pa'i mjug tu bsang mchod byas pa'i dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba smon lam rnams bya ba ni/

bkra shis bsngo ba'i rgyas gdab pa ste/ de dag gi gzhung gi tshig don rgyas pa ni/ mkhas grub rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bsang mchod kyi cho ga tshad ldan rnams las 'byung ba ltar shes par bya'o// go rim de dag dang rjes su mthun par bsang mchod cho ga skye ba lnga ba'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba kho bos byas pa zhig kyang yod pa de'i tshig don la dpyad kyang blo gros gsal bar 'gyur ba'ang srid do// spyi don gsum pa mjug phan yon bstan pa ni/ de ltar bsang mchod 'bul ba'i don tshul bzhin shes pa rnams kyis ni/ bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi snying po'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i rgyu tshogs phun sum tshogs pa ste/ ji skad du/ zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// zhes 'byung ba ltar sbyin pa rnam bzhi la sogs pa tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho rgyas pa'i rgyur 'gro ba'i phyir dang*/ gnas skabs su/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung*/ dme yugs btsog dang ro grib la sogs pa'i grib dang mi gtsang pa nyes sgrib kyis phog pa thams cad sbyang ba dang*/ mkhar khang brtsigs pa/ che sar dbang bskur ba/ gzhir sdod pa/ byes su 'gro ba la sogs pa'i rnam pa kun gyi bar du gcod pa zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen bya ba gang brtsams pa dang bsam don thams cad yin bzhin du 'grub par/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha srung thams cad kyis grogs byed pas 'grub par 'gyur ba'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa'o// de ltar mi shes pa'i so so'i skye bo'am/ mu stegs byed dam/ bon po'am/ gto mkhan phal gyi lugs ltar gnas skabs kyi rkyen sel tsam du dmigs pa'i mchod tshul dman pa dag gis kyang*/ 'phral gyi 'dod don 'bras bu phra mo 'byin pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba som nyi ci zhig ste/ mchod yul 'jig rten las 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa'i mgron rigs phan gnod kyi byed por gyur pa'i phyir ro// 'dir smras pa/

tshul 'di lung rigs dang bral gzu lum ste// ngal byas snying po phra zhes snying gi gtam// mchid bur gleng ba thos gang yid gdung bas// yid ches legs bshad 'tshol la mngon par phyogs// gang tshe dri med lung rigs las 'phos pa'i// dpyad gsum dag pas yang dag mchod sbyin bsang*// brnyas pa'i gnas su gyi nar 'phyan pa gang*// mdo sngags chos kyi phrin las mnga' dbang gsol// bsung zhim ci 'dod 'jo ba'i dpag bsam shing*// mchod yul mchod dang sems can don sgrub pas// tshogs bsags nyes tshogs sbyang ba'i stobs rdzogs na// bsang mchod bskrun pa'i yon tan rjes su 'gro// skyabs yul lta sgom spyod tshul nongs pa'i rgyu// bsnyad du med par khungs bral glo bur chos// 'chad par gad mo khong nas bro yang deng*// snyigs ma'i skye bo'i spyod tshul dran pa'i shugs// 'phags pa'i mchog rnams mchod pas de dag gi /yon tan rtse mor dbyung bya ma mchis mod// rang gzhan rgyud kyi nyes ltung kun sbyongs nas// bde legs 'byung ba de dag thugs rje'i stobs// mchod sbyin gnyer ba 'khor ba'i bza' tsho min// mchod sprin spro ba mthong chos so nam min// gzhan phan bsam pa bu smad phyir ma yin// gang phyir 'bad pa 'dir yang mi spro med// 'di byas dge ba'i chu gter lam gsum 'bab// yid bzhin nor bu ji bzhin sems can rnams// nyams med bsod nams ring por 'tsho ba'i tshe// 'dzad med dpal 'byor dgyes dgur rtsen phyir bsngo// zhes bsang mchod kyi cho ga'i rnam par bshad pa tshogs gnyis chu gter 'phel ba'i zla ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rga lung mchod rten dkar po'i phyogs nas sngags kyi cho ga dang rtsis rig sogs gtsug lag la sbyangs stobs mi dman pa'i bla mkhyen o rgyan dpal bzang pa nas/ bsil ldan ljongs 'dir bsang mchod kyi dar srol shin tu che ba mchis mod/ 'ga' zhig bon lugs las dar ba yin zhes pa dang*/

bod 'dir slob dpon pad+mas zhi brngan bsang gsum gyi cho ga thog mar mdzad pa mthong ba tsam las/ de las gzhan pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung rnams nas/ dngos sam shugs las bstan pa yod med kyi gsal kha sogs byung khungs dang*/ bsang gi sbyor dngos rjes gsum gdams pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ 'di gar bris pa las tshan nyung shas kyi kha ta dgos pa dang*/ rang nyid snyom las kyi khur bu mi chung tsam 'degs dgos kyi zhar byung du 'phros tshul gyi gleng ba nyung zad bcas 'di/ rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po brgyud par bcas pa'i legs gsungs zil mngar gyis 'tsho ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen nam/ 'byung du rung ba'i yon tan la smon pa'i btags ming du/ ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde can gyis/ lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
